sources.page: Blender Manual, Shader Nodes > Shader > Principled BSDF; Material Output node
sources.section: Inputs (Base Color, Metallic, Roughness, Alpha, Normal, Emission Color); Displacement
sources.facts: The consumer inputs each map feeds: colour maps (Base Color, Emission Color), scalar maps (Metallic, Roughness, Alpha), the tangent-space normal through a Normal Map node, displacement through the Material Output's Displacement.
Blender consumes the exported normal as OpenGL (+Y) tangent space, Non-Color; BaseColor sRGB; Roughness and Metallic Raw.

Files Painter wrote through this preset on an OCIO-managed UzmiGames project, in this order: <set>_BaseColor_sRGB, _Normal_Raw, _Metallic_Raw, _Roughness_Raw, _Emission_sRGB, _Alpha_Raw, _Displacement_Raw (the delivery kept the five present maps); the preset's resource URL and its version.

Delivered files named <TextureSet>_<Map>_sRGB.png or _Raw.png (for example 18-Tunica DefaultMaterial_Normal_Raw.png, 13-Grimorio Grimorio_BaseColor_sRGB.png): the colour-space suffix appears on OCIO projects.

packing.decision: No per-map parameters: file format, bit depth, padding and dithering come from exportParameters until the recording shows what the preset itself sets

pending.what: Painter's files and dry run for resource://starter_assets/Blender (Principled BSDF) on a UzmiGames fixture with every channel the preset reads filled distinctly, with and without an exportParameters rule, under legacy and OCIO colour management: confirms or corrects every map, its channels, its name and the preset's own parameters.
BaseColor (sRGB8) is exported sRGB-encoded; the encoding is recorded but not fitted (decision 090), so every export writing it is refused before writing.
